data.title: WeIND UP – Game Environment Project (Team Project)
data.description:
WeIND UP is a team-based cooperative puzzle game environment project currently in development.

I translated 2D environment concept art into a fully realized 3D world in Unreal Engine, focusing on establishing mood, spatial composition, and visual coherence.
My work involved building the environment through mesh placement, prop creation, and lighting, ensuring atmospheric consistency and clear gameplay readability for cooperative puzzle interaction.

Level design was handled by a dedicated level designer, and my responsibility was to execute and enhance the environment within the established layout through visual and atmospheric direction.
